value.rationale: The seven-label triangle-free two-matching complex is the canonical finite instance associated to a classical degree-bounded graph constraint and a currently studied clique-free-complex functor. The precise nonpure mixed-dimensional integral sphere wedge and its complete rational symmetric-group representation are structural invariants not recoverable from optimization, Betti ranks of other graph complexes or a simple smaller-n substitution. The nonzero degree-four class and 146 degree-five classes are motivated by the significant torsion and equivariant topology questions in nearby bounded-degree complexes.
